title: GB F-gas recovery, reclaim and recycle QA controls

sources.title: Recovering, reclaiming and recycling F gas
Fluorinated gas (F gas): guidance for users, producers and traders

facts.source_fact: A qualified technician must recover F gases from covered equipment including at end of life.
Covered equipment includes commercial and industrial refrigeration systems.
Covered equipment includes stationary air conditioning and heat pumps.
Covered equipment includes stationary fire protection and high-voltage switchgear.
For other equipment recovery is required where technically feasible and proportionate in cost.
Recovered waste F gas or whole units must go via an appropriate registered waste carrier to a licensed accepting facility.
Unnecessary intentional release of F gas to atmosphere is unlawful and may attract enforcement.
Recycled F gas means re-use after a basic cleaning process.
Recycled F gas above the stated GWP threshold has restricted reuse conditions described in the guidance.
Recovery/recycling compliance records do not by themselves prove a quantified emission reduction.
